gen-gf-paprika-gf-lexend-deca: Lexend Deca draws one plain, unshaded line, never swelling. Beside the commanding Paprika, its lowercase runs on without thick-thin swings, terminals stopping short of curling back, so paragraphs of it feel unhurried.
gen-gf-paprika-gf-liter: Loud, scattered letters up top, then a marker-tip line below. Paprika earns its keep big and brief, while Liter, a sans-serif with strong vertical lowercase and wide-mouthed rounds, handles the quieter lines.
gen-gf-paprika-gf-matangi: Matangi reads like laser-cut sheet, one stroke width throughout, with hefty lowercase and rounded letters left gently open. Shrink Paprika too small and its commanding swagger quietly drains away.
gen-gf-paprika-gf-maven-pro: Paprika scatters its letters wide and lets lowercase fill the line like capitals, its hollow counters breathing open. Maven Pro follows with gentle, uniform lines and a high-waisted lowercase.
gen-gf-paprika-gf-mochiy-pop-p-one: Paprika, commanding and scattered, loses its swagger entirely if made small. Mochiy Pop P One spaces its sizable lowercase far apart, in a bent-paperclip line with no thick-thin shifts.
gen-gf-paprika-gf-mozilla-text: Paprika lets its lowercase fill the line like capitals, with counters opened like a cut reed. And Mozilla Text, a sans-serif with tall bodies and flared terminals, gives page after page a bold-looking texture.
gen-gf-paprika-gf-nokora: Nokora reads dark and sturdy, a thick stripe of lowercase through every line, its s never tightening. But Paprika overhead shouts in scattered, capital-sized lowercase, giving each layout a loud top and a dense floor.
gen-gf-paprika-gf-noto-sans-adlam: Paprika shouts in scattered, capital-sized lowercase with hollow, breathing counters. Noto Sans Adlam, a sans, keeps curve endings well apart and its c, s and z tall and full.
gen-gf-paprika-gf-noto-sans-arabic: Expressive Paprika scatters its letters wide, lowercase filling the line like capitals. Noto Sans Arabic, a sans with wide openings on small letters, takes a generous size well thanks to its pronounced x-height.
gen-gf-paprika-gf-noto-sans-bamum: Paprika spreads loud, commanding letters across the line, its lowercase filling space like capitals and its counters opened like a cut reed. Noto Sans Bamum adds big open counters to every small letter.
